name: Rice-snail pancake
summary: The provincial tourism overview, 4 November 2021, names bánh xèo ốc gạo among the local coconut dishes. A batter and a street were not printed there. The 9 June 2021 town pancake is rice batter with coconut milk and turmeric, filled at one counter with clam, shrimp, pork, and cassava. A price is check on arrival.
origin: Named on the provincial tourism overview of 4 November 2021.
howToEat: Order it by this name. The overview does not print a batter or a herb plate. The town pancake with turmeric, coconut milk, clam, shrimp, pork, and cassava is the 9 June 2021 plate.
A stall price was not printed. The price is check on arrival.
where: The overview does not name a door. Check on arrival.
